full_page.content:
1946, August 14th
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph O'Donnell
Page 2
I am surely pleased to know that the Garland Family is doing so well and that Rae and Mrs. - Sr. - enjoyed their privileged pilgrimage to the famous shrines of St. Joseph and good St. Ann. May they live long and have many such happy experiences.
Thanks be to God for everything. Sincerely Yours in Christ
August 20th 1946.
P.S .- like.
Thanks be to God and our Blessed Mother - The Mystical City of God - the good rain has come! Everyone a person meets seems to appreciate the great good it has done. Praised be His Holy Name !
Yes I would be glad to see you again some of these beautiful days. However, just incidently, the third Sunday of the month is visiting day for the novices and that is more or less a pritty busy day, especially for the laybrothe and the novices themselves. Another day, therefore, might be preferable.
Please pardon brevity. Sincerely Yours in Christ, Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
